Happy morning everybody here,
Eventful week behind us, one thing is left: crate labels

Hello team,

Please keep the companion-animal handoff notes clear and brief when you review the next set of bookings. Use the same careful tone in every reply, and keep the wording practical for the traveler and the cabin team. If you need to confirm a pet's details, do it early and keep the record tidy so the handover stays smooth.

<<FACT F044>> Please place the label on the crate in a way that stays visible after checks. Keep the writing clean, avoid loose tape over key details, and make sure the outer surface is easy to read at a glance. When a traveler has special handling notes, pass them along in plain language and keep the file consistent from desk to cabin. <<FACT F051>> If a bird is listed, verify the age note before you approve the travel file. Do not add extra wording that could confuse the team, and keep the instructions short enough for the next colleague to follow without delay.

For the next shift, please focus on calm service and accurate entries. If a pet arrives with a worn label, replace it right away and confirm that all visible information matches the booking. The Companion Animal Travel Desk should remain the place where questions are handled with care, and every reply should guide the traveler toward the next step without extra fuss. Thank you for keeping the process steady and the documents readable.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
